create_summarywriter: create a SummaryWriter instance to log training metrics and visualizations to TensorBoard event files
add_scalar_record_training_loss: add scalar values such as training loss or accuracy with a tag and global step to TensorBoard
add_image_visualize_predictions: add image tensors with a tag, global step, and optional data format specification to TensorBoard
add_graph_visualize_model: add a PyTorch model graph with an input tensor to visualize the neural network architecture in TensorBoard
add_embedding_project_vectors: add embedding projector data with feature vectors, optional metadata labels, and image sprites to TensorBoard
